name.text: Arrival local time after a flight

questiontext.text:
An aircraft flies along the equator from \([[if test="is(ix=1)"]]37^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=2)"]]37^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=3)"]]0^\circ[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=4)"]]3^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=5)"]]20^\circ\,\mathrm{W}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=6)"]]37^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=7)"]]9^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=8)"]]45^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=9)"]]37^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=10)"]]15^\circ\,\mathrm{W}[[/if]]\) to \([[if test="is(ix=1)"]]10^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=2)"]]5^\circ\,\mathrm{W}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=3)"]]37^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=4)"]]40^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=5)"]]30^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=6)"]]15^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=7)"]]37^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=8)"]]10^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=9)"]]10^\circ\,\mathrm{W}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=10)"]]20^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]]\) at \({@v@}\) knots. It leaves at \([[if test="is(floor(mod(dep,1440)/60)<10)"]]0[[/if]]{@floor(mod(dep,1440)/60)@}:[[if test="is(mod(mod(dep,1440),60)<10)"]]0[[/if]]{@mod(mod(dep,1440),60)@}\) local time.

(a) Find the flight time, to the nearest minute.

[[input:ans1]] h [[input:ans2]] min [[validation:ans1]] [[validation:ans2]] [[feedback:prt1]]

(b) Find the local time on arrival, to the nearest minute. Use the 24-hour clock.

[[input:ans3]] : [[input:ans4]] [[validation:ans3]] [[validation:ans4]] [[feedback:prt2]]

generalfeedback.text:
(a) The difference in longitude is \({@abs(dl)@}^\circ = {@nm@}'\), so the distance along the equator is \({@nm@}\) nm. Time \(= {@nm@} \div {@v@} = {@dispdp(float(nm/v),3)@}\) h \(= {@floor(fr/60)@}\) h \({@mod(fr,60)@}\) min.

(b) By the clock of the starting place the aircraft lands at \([[if test="is(floor(mod(floor(noadj+1/2),1440)/60)<10)"]]0[[/if]]{@floor(mod(floor(noadj+1/2),1440)/60)@}:[[if test="is(mod(mod(floor(noadj+1/2),1440),60)<10)"]]0[[/if]]{@mod(mod(floor(noadj+1/2),1440),60)@}\). It flew [[if test="east"]]east[[else]]west[[/if]] through \({@abs(dl)@}^\circ\), so local time is \({@4*abs(dl)@}\) minutes [[if test="east"]]ahead[[else]]behind[[/if]]: it arrives at \([[if test="is(floor(mod(ar,1440)/60)<10)"]]0[[/if]]{@floor(mod(ar,1440)/60)@}:[[if test="is(mod(mod(ar,1440),60)<10)"]]0[[/if]]{@mod(mod(ar,1440),60)@}\) local time.

questiondescription.text:
Navigation: arrival local time

Grade 12 CBE Core 2.7 (g) / Essential 2.3 (f): Find the time for a flight along the equator and its local arrival time, allowing for the change of longitude.

Core and Essential

This question is original to this project.

truefeedback.text: The time is right, but minutes run from 0 to 59: \(60\) min \(= 1\) h.

falsefeedback.text: [[if test="is(T1>0)"]]In \({@ans1@}\) h \({@ans2@}\) min at \({@v@}\) knots the aircraft would fly \({@dispdp(yd,1)@}\) nm, which is \({@dispdp(yd/60,1)@}^\circ\) along the equator. Compare that with the difference in longitude between \([[if test="is(ix=1)"]]37^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=2)"]]37^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=3)"]]0^\circ[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=4)"]]3^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=5)"]]20^\circ\,\mathrm{W}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=6)"]]37^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=7)"]]9^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=8)"]]45^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=9)"]]37^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=10)"]]15^\circ\,\mathrm{W}[[/if]]\) and \([[if test="is(ix=1)"]]10^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=2)"]]5^\circ\,\mathrm{W}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=3)"]]37^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=4)"]]40^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=5)"]]30^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=6)"]]15^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=7)"]]37^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=8)"]]10^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=9)"]]10^\circ\,\mathrm{W}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=10)"]]20^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]]\). [[/if]]Along the equator \(1'\) of longitude is \(1\) nm. Time \(=\) distance \(\div\) speed, in hours; multiply the decimal part of an hour by 60 to change it to minutes.

truefeedback.text: The time is right, but hours run from 0 to 23 and minutes from 0 to 59 on the 24-hour clock.

That is the time by the clock of the starting place. Change to local time at \([[if test="is(ix=1)"]]10^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=2)"]]5^\circ\,\mathrm{W}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=3)"]]37^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=4)"]]40^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=5)"]]30^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=6)"]]15^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=7)"]]37^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=8)"]]10^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=9)"]]10^\circ\,\mathrm{W}[[/if]][[if test="is(ix=10)"]]20^\circ\,\mathrm{E}[[/if]]\): \({@4*abs(dl)@}\) minutes [[if test="east"]]ahead[[else]]behind[[/if]].
The aircraft flew [[if test="east"]]east, so local time gains[[else]]west, so local time loses[[/if]] \({@4*abs(dl)@}\) minutes.
Your method is right for your flight time in (a), but (a) is wrong.

falsefeedback.text: By the clock of the starting place, your flight time in (a) has the aircraft landing at \([[if test="is(floor(mod(dep+T1,1440)/60)<10)"]]0[[/if]]{@floor(mod(dep+T1,1440)/60)@}:[[if test="is(mod(mod(dep+T1,1440),60)<10)"]]0[[/if]]{@mod(mod(dep+T1,1440),60)@}\). Your arrival time is [[if test="is(ya>0)"]]\({@ya@}\) minutes ahead of that[[else]][[if test="is(ya<0)"]]\({@-ya@}\) minutes behind that[[else]]the same as that[[/if]][[/if]]. The aircraft flew [[if test="east"]]east[[else]]west[[/if]] through \({@abs(dl)@}^\circ\) of longitude, and local time changes by \(4\) minutes for each degree: ahead to the east, behind to the west.
